title: ANTIBODY: STRENGTHENING DEFENSE AGAINST HARMFUL FINE-TUNING FOR LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS VIA ATTENUATING HARMFUL GRADIENT INFLUENCE
reasoning: The paper proposes a defense strategy called Antibody to protect the safety alignment of Large Language Models against harmful fine-tuning attacks. While its evaluation uses safety metrics that involve harmful categories (like discrimination), the research is focused on security and alignment preservation rather than benchmarking religious values, moral reasoning frameworks, or specific ethical philosophies.
